specific_objectives: 21.1.10.1 Trainee will be able to explain how to carry out DI / DR on aircraft system.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration and supervised practice of DI/DR procedures on aircraft system; Safety: Verify system isolation and power-off status; Supervision: Instructor monitors trainee actions and verifies checklist completion.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of a Distance Indicator?
Define the function of a Distance Remaining indicator.
List two safety precautions before operating the DI/DR system.

development.content:
System power isolation verification
Control panel location identification
Mode selection switch operation
Distance input knob adjustment
Display readout interpretation

Calibration procedure execution
Error source identification
Troubleshooting common faults
Reset sequence initiation
System status verification

Final system check completion
Documentation of test results
Handover of control to instructor
Debriefing of operational steps
Sign-off on practical checklist

summary_questions: Explain the step-by-step procedure for calibrating the DI system.
Describe how to identify a discrepancy between the DI and DR readings.
List the three critical safety checks required before engaging the system.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the wiring diagram components related to the DI/DR system to be analyzed in the next lesson (LP 15).

pft_rows.syllabus: Practical on identifying various components and analyzing of Wiring diagram manual.
